name: Kurohane
source:
A notorious serial killer in the Prison, always leaves behind a scene of gruesome bodies after kill. The victims' bodies were so torn up that some doubt whether or not it was even done by a human being.

[spoiler]He is actually the older brother of [url=/c520]Fione[/url], Kugel. He became Black Feather due to being captured and experimented upon after attempting to find the truth behind the Asylum.[/spoiler]
